first_divergence.exact_span: draft-v4.tex:230-239 — ‘Pressure has to travel with every response. The compact tower is’ and the ensuing Q_r/V_{r+1} display.
first_divergence.mechanism: The prose moves from the differentiated momentum recurrence to a pressure-complete tower, but R_i appears without definition and the pressure identity has not been obtained from incompressibility. A reader who knows basic PDE cannot infer the first displayed equality for Q_r from the material already established, so the second tower equation arrives with an unearned pressure closure.
first_divergence.repair_constraint: Before displaying the compact tower, take divergence of the r-th differentiated equation, use div V_a = 0 to obtain the pressure Poisson relation, and define R_i with its sign convention. Keep this as a compact causal join between the explicit time derivatives and the pressure-complete recurrence.
